subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-10-15
html:
Rank stayed flat for a 17th straight week (0 of 22 tracked keywords, avg position 100; backlinks flat 3/2 referring domains since 09-10). CI stayed green: 51/51 SEO Report Email runs all-time. catalog.ts/destinations/catalog.ts are both unchanged — shareable_dashboard's "October 2026" ETA still hasn't flipped despite the month being half over. A fresh 20-term FOCUS keyword pull found every term with real volume either already targeted by a live connector/comparison/blog page, or gated on a still-coming_soon connector — the MCP-integration content engine (5/5 connector pages, 5/5 named comparisons, 10 blog posts) remains fully exhausted against current demand.

With no new keyword-driven page to build, this session re-checked public/llms.txt — the file meant to hand AI crawlers a curated map of the site — against the live app's actual routes rather than trusting the file's own prose. Found and fixed one real dead link.

PageWhat ChangedTarget KeywordCheck It
public/llms.txt (not a rendered page — the AI-crawler site map file)Its "Pages" list linked to https://askarlo.app/services, a hub page that no longer exists in the app (confirmed live: it 404s). The route was removed at some point after llms.txt was written and nobody updated the file to match. Removed the dead line — no replacement was needed, since all 5 real persona pages (SEO Specialist, Google Ads Specialist, Meta Ads Specialist, Account Manager, Agency Owner) are already linked individually, by name, in the file's "Who ARLO Is For" section just above it.N/A — AI-citation/crawler-accuracy fixaskarlo.app/llms.txt — the dead /services link under "## Pages" is gone; askarlo.app/services still correctly 404s (confirming the fix targeted a real dead end, not a page that should be rebuilt).

Next: keep re-pulling the FOCUS keyword cluster fresh each session and watch for any gated connector (Meta Ads, Shopify, HubSpot, etc.) or the shareable_dashboard destination flipping off coming_soon — that's the next real content lever. Everything else code-actionable and human-independent across the technical/on-page/SXO/GEO audits is now closed; remaining open items (GSC submission, off-page outreach, AI Result Tracker setup, a real CSP, the www redirect, IndexNow, a second case study) all need a human decision.
